scope: Markdown inline/reference/autolinks, GitHub plain HTTP(S) autolinks and HTML href/src, excluding fenced/indented/inline code; links within PDFs, DOCX, binaries, archives or executable source not parsed. GitHub heading anchors approximated and flagged anchors manually reviewed.
preservation: Historical documents and release snapshots retained without rewriting their relative links. Recovery routes supplement them; they do not make broken historical links work in place.

external_http.scope: HTTP reachability only; external page fragments, redirect content, access permissions and scientific contents not certified.
